en: An old monochrome postcard with a small photograph printed in the upper left showing a cobblestoned square bordered by multi‑story buildings and a church spire in the background. A tall column or monument stands near the center of the square, which is enclosed by a fence. Beneath and beside the image are decorative flourishes and German text. The right side of the card is blank for writing. In the lower right corner small print credits a printer in Riga.
